decisions.rationale: The supplied SVG shows both animateTransform elements (horse-gallop, rider-bob) have begin="indefinite", so neither animation autoplays. Plan A directly addresses this observed fault by changing begin to 0s while preserving artwork, dur, repeatCount, and targets. Plans B and C also alter begin, but B keeps a trigger requirement and C re-declares timing, making them less minimal and less directly supported than restoring autonomous playback.
